start: Admin app, Messages and offers; the gym already sent 2 messages today

steps.action: Write a title (up to 60) and text (up to 300), tap send
user_sees: 'This is your 3rd message today, so members get it in the app without a phone pop-up.'
The message in the Sent list, marked quiet
must_not: Members' phones popping up for the 3rd message
The message missing from members' message list

start: Admin app, Messages and offers; 10 messages already sent today

user_sees: Refused: too many messages today (TOO_MANY)
must_not: An 11th message sent
The typed text lost without a warning

steps.action: Send with an empty title, or a title over 60 / text over 300
user_sees: Refused: EMPTY or TOO_LONG
must_not: Text cut without a word

steps.action: Send a second offer or event today
user_sees: Refused (OFFER_TODAY); a 4th in a week is OFFER_WEEK
must_not: Two offers in one day

start: Two messages already sent today, one of them then taken back

user_sees: It still pops up on phones: a taken-back message does not count toward the 2
must_not: The new message marked quiet because of the taken-back one

user_sees: The taken-back message still counts toward the 10 a day (the limit counts every message made today)
must_not: The quiet count and the nudge disagreeing about which message is the 3rd

start: Admin app, Messages; a timed message and a message to a picked group

user_sees: It counts on tomorrow for the pop-up rule (the day it appears)
must_not: It made quiet because of today's messages

steps.action: Send to a picked group of members
user_sees: Only those members get it; recipients counted
must_not: Members outside the group getting it
A group of only left members sent (NO_ONE)

start: A message sent to a picked group of 3 members

steps.action: Members of the gym open their message list
user_sees: Only the 3 picked members see it; a pop-up goes only to their phones and only if it is one of the day's first 2
must_not: A member outside the group seeing it
A pop-up for the 3rd message of the day

start: Admin app signed in as front desk staff, Messages and offers

steps.action: Try to send a message to members
user_sees: The send is refused: only the owner sends messages (owner-only key check; app words unknown)
must_not: A message sent by a staff login
The typed text lost without a word

start: A staff person removed by the owner, admin app still open

steps.action: Try to send or open the Sent list
user_sees: Signed out: the session no longer works (BAD_KEY)
must_not: A message sent by a removed person

user_sees: The same refusal to send; the day's count unchanged by the staff try
must_not: The staff try counted toward the 10 a day

start: Member app joined to the gym; the gym sends 3 messages today

user_sees: A phone pop-up for each, and each in the Gym tab's messages
must_not: No pop-up for the first 2

user_sees: No pop-up; the message waits quietly in the Gym tab
must_not: A pop-up for the 3rd
The 3rd missing from the list

start: Member app closed; the gym's 1st message of the day arrives

user_sees: The app opens on the gym's message
must_not: The app opening on an empty screen

start: A member who left the gym

steps.action: The gym sends a message to everyone
user_sees: Nothing reaches the left member
must_not: A pop-up or message to someone who left

start: A quiet 3rd message waiting in the Gym tab

steps.action: Open the Gym tab and read it
user_sees: The message marked as read
must_not: A late pop-up for it on a new app (old apps may still pop it up)

steps.action: The gym takes the message back
user_sees: It goes from the list (app words unknown)
must_not: A taken-back message still shown as new

steps.action: Look at a message sent to a group they are not in
user_sees: Nothing: it is not in their list
must_not: Another member's group message shown
The names of other recipients shown
